name: Inbin Pulse
description: Pulse gives Claude real observed airfare history. Ask whether a fare is actually good and get a verdict computed from fares recorded on that route (comparable trip type and period), with the observed low, high, median, and sample size. A second tool lists the most-checked routes. Data comes from public fare observations and deal newsletters; every answer states its evidence and sample size, and Pulse never books, sells, or links payment

_published_faq.name: How do I add Inbin Pulse to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Inbin Pulse to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pulse.inbin.dev/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Inbin Pulse MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Inbin Pulse scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Inbin Pulse MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inbin Pulse provides these MCP tools: is_this_a_flight_deal and top_flight_routes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Inbin Pulse?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Inbin Pulse in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, Skimetric, and TiCATi.

_published_faq.name: Does Inbin Pulse MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inbin Pulse does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Inbin Pulse is developed by Inbin. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
